checks.name: static RTL review
checks.details: TopModule has exact specified ports, unsigned 100-bit data vectors, and a continuous combinational mux assignment. No clock, reset, storage, or pipeline.

checks.name: development simulation
checks.coverage: Both selector values for all-zero/all-one cases, 100 walking-bit complementary vectors, and 1000 random vector pairs.

development_outcome: Initial candidate passed all independent development checks without RTL revisions. candidate_initial.sv was preserved before development checks.
limitations: Official evaluation was not accessed and its results are unknown.
No synthesis, timing analysis, or board validation performed.
Development simulation is not exhaustive over all 100-bit input combinations.
